item.summary: fix(diagnostics): stalled lanes go unreported while messages keep arriving (#121380) * fix(diagnostics): report a stalled lane that keeps receiving messages The heartbeat attention gate opens on state.lastActivity, which logMessageQueuedWithBacklogPolicy refreshes for every queued inbound message. Everything behind that gate decides on the progress clock: classifySessionAttention takes no age at all, and the three is*RecoveryEligible rules read lastProgressAgeMs / activeToolAgeMs. So a lane wedged on owned work never reaches any of them while its user keeps typing, and the ownerless-lane release window never sees real staleness. Fold the owned-work progress age into the same gate and the same age the request already carries, the way repeated-request attention already does one screen above. * refactor(diagnostics): unify stalled-session attention clocks Co-authored-by: masatohoshino --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
